title: LINK-IT: Leveraging vIdeos and commuNity Health worKers to Improve Diabetes OuTcomes
official: LINK-IT: Leveraging vIdeos and commuNity Health worKers to Improve Diabetes OuTcomes
summary: The overall goal of this study is to examine the efficacy of the video-based Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES) (hereafter VIDEO), or the video-based DSMES+community health worker (CHW) intervention (hereafter VIDEO+CHW), compared with a wait-list control group (hereafter CONTROL) to improve glycemic control among Chinese Americans with uncontrolled type 2 diabetes in NYC.

interventions.name: Video-Based Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES)
